rootCause: Buddy set stdin to null before Linux activation required the private launch pipe. The failure occurs before the READY polling loop, independently of provider configuration.
repair: Linux Buddy stdin is piped for the private launch frame.
The parent stdin handle is dropped immediately after activation; no interactive provider input is sent.
Windows null stdin, service READY, namespace/cgroup checks, request identity, deadlines and complete-tree reaping are retained.

regression.strengthened: A real contained shell waits for EOF, rejects any input bytes and returns a fixed marker before the existing real-CLI callback journey.

independentReview.result: Concrete cause and Linux-only pipe/drop repair confirmed; no containment weakening.
